description: Oval bronze, knotted over with spirals, a ring at the top for a cord. It is a locket. It has never once opened.
lore: Opening it is the first thing everybody tries and the last thing anybody manages. Some have a hinge line under the knotwork and some have no hinge line whatsoever, and all of them are shut, and the trade has been quiet about that for a long while, on the grounds that eighty-five gold is a fair price and the question is not worth losing over.

Two facts sit side by side in [[lore/the_chronicle|the Chronicle]] with no third fact between them. They come up in the grass where [[monsters/rune_lion|Runemane]] walks. And they come off the black rock, grown in under the chest skin of a [[monsters/malformed_creature|Palehusk]] — a thing with nothing at all inside it, carrying, over the exact place a heart would sit, a container that has never been opened.
gm_notes: Same object from two find-sites with nothing linking them; most likely explanation is that it was a common piece of jewellery in some era, which is the explanation Bettany cannot make herself accept. Leave both open. Never decide what is inside.
